diagnosis: Path.convert compares rv against both bytes and str dash sentinels in a tuple, which emits BytesWarning under python -bb and becomes an error with -Werror. The fix constructs a sentinel with the same type as rv and compares only against that value.
label_note: Human-curated from the issue, fix commit, and merged PR. Changed-file labels are proxies; diagnosis must be scored separately. Never pass this file to the agents.
evaluation_note: The original issue links to a nearby source-code location and suggests converting the data type. Use this case as a smoke demonstration, not as a blind-localization benchmark.
